---
title: "Analysis"
---

Four notebooks turn the raw files into counts, tables, and figures. Each reads from `data/raw/` or `data/processed/` and writes only to `data/processed/`. No notebook changes a raw file. Deleting `data/processed/` and rerunning the notebooks in order rebuilds it.

| Notebook | Reads | Writes |
|---|---|---|
| [01 Deduplication](01-deduplication.ipynb) | `raw/search_exports/`, `raw/dedup_decisions.csv` (optional) | `processed/deduplicated_records.csv`, `processed/duplicate_groups.csv`, `processed/possible_duplicates.csv`, the identification counts in `processed/screening_counts.yaml` |
| [02 Screening](02-screening.ipynb) | `processed/deduplicated_records.csv`, `raw/screening_exports/`, `codebook.yml` | The screening and inclusion counts in `processed/screening_counts.yaml`, `processed/included_reports.csv` |
| [03 Charting](03-charting.ipynb) | `raw/included_sources_raw.csv`, `raw/included_factors_raw.csv`, `codebook.yml`, `processed/deduplicated_records.csv`, `processed/included_reports.csv` | `processed/included_sources_clean.csv`, `processed/included_factors_clean.csv`, `processed/bibliography.csv` |
| [04 Synthesis](04-synthesis.ipynb) | `processed/screening_counts.yaml`, `processed/included_sources_clean.csv`, `processed/included_factors_clean.csv`, `processed/bibliography.csv` | `processed/prisma_flow.png` |

## Record identifiers

Each deduplicated record has a `record_id`. It is a hash of the key of the earliest exported record in its group, so it stays the same when a later search adds records or finds the same records again. This holds only while the earlier exports stay in `data/raw/search_exports/`. Screening decisions and charted data refer to these identifiers. If a later search joins two groups that were separate, one identifier is retired, and notebook 01 lists the change.

## Checks

Notebooks 02, 03, and 04 stop with an error when the data break a rule, and they write nothing until the problem is fixed. The rules include an unknown `record_id`, a record with no screening decision, a value outside `codebook.yml`, an empty required cell, and flow counts that do not add up. Warnings, such as a charted source with no factors, are printed and do not stop the run.

## Running

Install Quarto and the Python packages in `requirements.txt`. Then render one notebook at a time, in order, as data arrives.

```bash
quarto render analysis/01-deduplication.ipynb
```

The site is set to `freeze: true`, so a full `quarto render` reuses the stored results in `_freeze/` and does not rerun the notebooks. After the data change, render the affected notebooks explicitly. A change to `codebook.yml` also needs `quarto render codebook.qmd` and `quarto render materials/screening-guide.qmd`, which print it. Commit `_freeze/` so the site builds without rerunning them.
